subject: OTLP rate-cap certification and reseller governance

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 09 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: OTLP rate-cap certification and reseller governance

Hi Elena / Tom —

Following up from last week's alliance review: we kicked off an internal spike to define a lightweight conformance path for OTLP exporters that we expect our partners to pass before marketplace listing. The primary ask from engineering was: agree on a small set of rate-cap and sampling guarantees so customers see predictable behaviour when routing telemetry through third-party sinks.

Draft asks (attached: otlp-ratecap-spec-v0.1.pdf):
- Target production throughput: define per-tenant EPS bands (e.g., 5k / 25k / 100k) and accepted failure modes.
- Backpressure behaviour: how exporters should behave when upstream rejects / rate-limits.
- Sampling interoperability: recommended sampling flags and a short test harness.
- Reseller governance: minimum support SLAs and co-marketing commitments before we publish partner badges.

We'd like to:
1) Validate Datadog/Grafana/Observify accept these EPS bands or propose alternatives.
2) Agree on 2-week interoperability test in our sandbox (we can provide test tokens).
3) Lock minimal reseller governance terms (POC support windows, joint comms) so legal can bake it into the MOA.

Can you confirm availability for a 30-min call next week? Possible slots: Mon 13th 10:00-10:30 PT or Tue 14th 14:00-14:30 PT.

Thanks — Ben
Ben Carter
Partner Solutions, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0192

From: Elena Soto <elena@datadoghq.com>

Date: Wed, 09 Dec 2026 11:01:00 -0800
Subject: Re: OTLP rate-cap certification and reseller governance

Thanks Ben — solid start.

Quick notes from Datadog infra team after a rapid read of the spec (attached: datadog-otlp-guidelines.pdf):
- EPS bands look fine but we typically validate against a 50k EPS per-org gating criteria for marketplace partners. Can we make the mid-band 50k rather than 25k?
- Backpressure: we prefer pushback with HTTP 429 + Retry-After semantics (we have tooling to simulate this in our sandbox).
- Sampling: agree on the flags but would like explicit examples for head-based vs tail-based sampling and a short curl-based test that asserts preserved trace ids.

We can join the sandbox run. Tue 14th 14:00 PT works for me — will put a calendar invite.

Elena Soto
Partner Eng, Datadog
elena@datadoghq.com

Ben / Elena —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. A couple of product/field considerations from my side:
- Reseller governance: we should require a 48-hour POC support window for any listed partner and a templated escalation matrix (level 1/2/3). That keeps field enablement predictable for our sales teams.
- Co-marketing: propose a single joint tech brief and one joint webinar within the first quarter of listing — that'll be a minimum commitment for the "verified" badge.
- Legal: I'll loop in commercial counsel if we land on EPS thresholds & support SLAs — that will help us finalize the partner-moa-draft.docx.

Also tagging Soojin to scope an automated smoke test that asserts rate-cap behaviour (Soojin — can you draft a short Jenkins/CI job that runs against the sandbox token?).
